source_name: Prozorro tender UA-2025-12-31-001925-a — Tieto Card Suite support (worked example)
why_relevant: Concrete proof that card-processing platform vendors are identifiable in Prozorro: the notice names SIA Tietoevry Banking Latvia as sole rights holder for 'Tieto Card Suite' and the sole licensor in Ukraine, under CPV 72261000-2 (software support services). This is exactly the kind of record that maps an incumbent core/card platform to a specific institution, and it establishes CPV 72261000-2 as a high-yield filter.

source_name: Cabinet of Ministers — resolution on independent information-security audit of critical infrastructure
why_relevant: Primary legal basis for the audit cadence (every 2–3 years by criticality category) and auditor qualification rules; sets the recurring demand cycle that assurance vendors sell into.

source_name: НБУ — нормативні акти щодо реєстрації ПРОСТІР та проєкти постанов (admin_uploads/law)
why_relevant: NBU regulations and draft resolutions published as PDFs under bank.gov.ua/admin_uploads/. These define the registration rules, the participant categories and the technical/certification obligations that determine which vendors can serve the market. Critically for collection engineering, the /admin_uploads/ file paths appear to bypass the WAF that returns 403 on the HTML pages, making them the practical route into NBU primary material.

source_name: Ministry of Economy of Ukraine — Mastercard/Visa government partnership announcements
why_relevant: State-side confirmation of scheme MoUs (digital partnership, 'Зроблено в Україні' national cashback) — these MoUs pull banks, processors and acquirers into implementation roles, so the ministry text often names the delivery partners.

source_name: Дія Бізнес — довідник підприємця: картка Асоціації ЄМА
why_relevant: State-run business handbook entry describing EMA's role and membership scope (payment systems, banks, financial companies, payment providers, MFOs). Government-hosted, stable, unlikely to be bot-defended — a good low-risk corroboration source for association descriptions and possibly a directory of other sector bodies.

source_name: НБУ — Перелік важливих об'єктів платіжної інфраструктури в Україні
why_relevant: The NBU periodically designates and publishes a list of 'important payment infrastructure objects' based on payment-system oversight monitoring. This is a regulator-curated shortlist of the systemically significant systems and operators — effectively a ranked, named tier-1 target list, far more selective than the full register, and updated by news release so the changes are datable.

source_name: Sense Bank — official POS-terminal service organisation contacts (help-biz KB)
why_relevant: Bank support article that names the outsourced service organisation(s) handling its merchant POS terminals. Bank knowledge bases of this type are one of the very few places where the bank→service-provider link is stated in public rather than inferred. Pattern is replicable across other UA banks' merchant help centres.

source_name: Ekonomichna Pravda long-form on PROSTIR ('Своя платіжна система')
why_relevant: Analytical journalism on why PROSTIR under-performs against Visa/Mastercard, with named participants, processor economics and interchange context — good for the competitive framing of the national switch versus international schemes.

source_name: DOU.ua editorial — annual rating of Ukrainian banks by number of IT specialists
why_relevant: Ranks banks by in-house IT headcount (PrivatBank, Raiffeisen, PUMB, Oschadbank, Sense Bank leading) and explains structural facts such as monobank sitting outside the ranking because it is built by Fintech Band with Universal Bank. Gives the prioritised actor list for all other indirect-signal collection and dates in-housing vs. vendor dependence.

source_name: EBRD Ukraine procurement briefing deck hosted by Prozorro Infobox
why_relevant: A 2025 EBRD briefing on project procurement and opportunities in Ukraine — explains the current notice channels, thresholds and pipeline framing straight from the Bank, which is the methodological key to collecting the rest of this cell correctly.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — картка організації в Опендатабот (ЄДРПОУ 30401000)
why_relevant: Registry mirror for the association's own legal entity (EDRPOU 30401000, registered 29.04.1999) giving officers, address and filing history. Confirms the association's legal identity and, via founder/officer records, links to individuals who also sit in member institutions. Same pattern applies to UAFIC (EDRPOU 42031209).

source_name: World Bank — Vienna Development Knowledge Center, digital payments in Europe & Central Asia
why_relevant: Comparative regional data on digital-payment adoption placing Ukraine against ECA peers — supplies the benchmarking numbers international analyst notes reuse, from a source that publishes its methodology. Complements Findex micro-data.

source_name: AlixPartners — PrivatBank engagement case study
why_relevant: Consultancy case study on a named Ukrainian bank. Advisory-firm case pages are a parallel supplier-side channel that names Ukrainian financial institutions and describes transformation programmes that later generate technology procurement.

source_name: AWS / hyperscaler customer case studies — PrivatBank
why_relevant: Non-obvious supplier-side disclosure: the cloud provider published a named Ukrainian bank case study (PrivatBank migration under wartime conditions) with architecture and timeline detail that the bank's own releases omit. Demonstrates that hyperscaler case-study libraries belong in the vendor-reference cell alongside ATM/core vendors.

entity_name: Bank PCI DSS compliance disclosure pages
source_name: Bank PCI DSS compliance disclosure pages (e.g. Ukreximbank 'Міжнародний сертифікат PCI DSS Compliance')
why_relevant: Banks publish their own PCI DSS certification statements, sometimes naming the assessor and certified scope; systematically harvesting these across Ukrainian banks builds a compliance-driven vendor/assessor map.

source_name: Checkbox / fiscalisation certification blog — certified POS terminal models in Ukraine
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly: Ukrainian fiscalisation/PRRO providers publish which terminal hardware (Verifone, Newland) and which integrator (e.g. SSI) passed certification — a proxy for the certified terminal-vendor landscape that the schemes themselves do not publish locally.

entity_name: Journal of Finance and Financial Law / DOAJ
source_name: Journal of Finance and Financial Law / DOAJ — Ukrainian bank-fintech cooperation research
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed English-language academic work on bank–fintech cooperation models in Ukraine, typically naming specific banks and partner startups with dates. Slower and older than trade press but methodologically transparent and openly licensed, useful for building historical partnership timelines that news archives no longer surface.

entity_name: KeyCRM / SITNIKS / Brander and similar integrator blogs and integration pages
source_name: KeyCRM / SITNIKS / Brander and similar integrator blogs and integration pages
why_relevant: Ukrainian CRM/e-commerce software vendors and web agencies document exactly which PSPs they integrate and how, and often name merchant clients — an indirect but rich channel-level view of PSP adoption that PSPs themselves do not publish.

source_name: Kyivstar/Uklon–Visa Acceptance Platform announcement (GlobeNewswire syndication)
why_relevant: Concrete 2026 example of Visa's acceptance/gateway technology being adopted by a large Ukrainian non-bank merchant platform — evidence of scheme-owned vendor stack displacing local gateways. Wire syndication makes these findable when the scheme's own site does not carry them.

entity_name: Law-firm client briefings on Ukrainian open banking
source_name: Law-firm client briefings on Ukrainian open banking (Wolf Theiss, Ilyashev & Partners, via Lexology)
why_relevant: Law firms decode the AISP/PISP authorisation regime, deadlines and register mechanics in English, and often note which categories of provider are queuing for authorisation. Reliable for regime structure; weak on named vendors.

source_name: NBU Resolution No. 143 — information security requirements for non-bank financial institutions
why_relevant: Vendor/consultancy explainers of Postanova 143 map the control set non-bank payment institutions must implement by the compliance deadline — an early indicator of procurement demand and of which suppliers are positioning against each control.

source_name: OCP Data Registry — Ukraine: Prozorro publication record
why_relevant: Independent English-language assessment of the Prozorro OCDS publication: coverage, field completeness, known quality issues and access routes. Directly informs how far one can trust award/supplier fields and whether bulk download or API is the right route (registry guidance notes the bulk dataset is hundreds of GB and favours the API).

source_name: Odessa Journal / Silicon Canals / Sesamers — English secondary coverage of Ukrainian fintech funding
why_relevant: Second-tier English outlets that pick up Ukrainian fintech funding and valuation events (Fintech-IT Group / mono ecosystem unicorn round backed by the Ukraine-Moldova American Enterprise Fund, ~EUR 16.5m raise). Individually low-authority but collectively they fill gaps where Finextra and The Paypers do not run the item, and they often quote the vendor's own PR verbatim.

source_name: OECD — Mapping Ukraine's Financial Markets and Corporate Governance Framework
why_relevant: Vendor-neutral institutional analysis of the Ukrainian financial-market structure — the type of report the cell brief calls 'analyst notes and market reports mentioning Ukraine', but with an authoritative issuer and a citable, permanently archived PDF. Useful for market-structure baselines rather than deal news.

source_name: OTP Group (Hungary) global newsroom / vendor announcements about OTP
why_relevant: Group-level vendor selections (Intellect Design Arena eMACH.ai digital core & lending, contract Dec 2023; Iliad Solutions t3 payments testing platform, 2024) cascade into the Ukrainian subsidiary. Vendor press releases name the deal the bank itself may not announce locally.

source_name: Private Banker International — payment platform selection news
why_relevant: Trade-press coverage of OpenWay WAY4 selections; useful corroboration layer for vendor claims and for capturing deals reported to media but not published as vendor case studies.

source_name: TAPAS / spendingToData — методичні рекомендації з публікації договорів
why_relevant: Documents the exact dataset schemas for 'Фінансова звітність' and 'Перелік укладених договорів' published via spending.gov.ua. Tells you which fields exist in contract disclosures and therefore what a supplier-mapping pipeline can actually extract.

source_name: ТЗІ Україна — organisation of state expertise of КСЗІ
why_relevant: Explains the КСЗІ state-expertise process and the role of 'суб'єкти оцінювання' (evaluation subjects) listed by Держспецзв'язку — a pointer into the Ukrainian licensed-assessor population that audits bank and payment-system information systems.

source_name: Український каталог фінтех-компаній 2025 (UAFIC annual fintech catalog)
why_relevant: The single most complete enumeration of the Ukrainian fintech ecosystem: the 2025 edition covers 257 fintech companies with segmentation, and is produced by UAFIC with NBU, Ministry of Digital Transformation, IFC, SECO, GGF and Ukrainian Startup Fund support. A yearly, citable, downloadable actor census — ideal seed for an entity master list. The linked URL is a third-party mirror; the canonical copy sits on fintechua.org.
